stage1.impression: A handsome, well-composed CG interior: deep perspective, warm timber, a believable record wall and a nice coloured shadow on the concrete, but it reads as a render. The rainbow ring globe glows like LED tubing or a nightclub sign and dominates the frame, the foreground floor is lit by a hard, bright pool that does not match a night room of small practicals, and the EARF pair at the far end is a pair of tiny grey boxes nobody would notice. A magazine would see a specific place in the bones (record wall, altar, banquette), but this frame sells a neon sculpture over a fairly generic bar, not a listening bar.

blocking_9: Mother EARF reads as cast acrylic catching light (polished glowing edges, visible disc faces), not as neon tubes: its rims no brighter than the bar-top pools and its region's saturation no longer the loudest thing in the frame
The foreground floor is no longer the brightest large surface: region [150,600,480,800] lum_median at or below 55 and below the bar top
The altar pair reads at a glance as the destination of the room: region [510,350,565,435] lum_median >= 45 with the smoked tint and horn legible, not white boxes
One coherent set of practicals: every hard pool traceable to a visible Dome, Orb or spot; no daylight-like raking light across the floor
The zinc counter top reads as zinc (soft grey patina), not as a white stone slab with a hot sheen
Ceiling and timber read warm brown, not orange (ceiling r/b ratio well below the current 75/17)
Signs of craft polish: less uniform film-grain overlay, no near-invisible glass screen line cutting through the foreground table

defects.what: Mother EARF rims glow as saturated neon hoops; the 25 mm discs' faces barely register, so it reads as an LED sculpture or a nightclub sign, not cast acrylic

Hard, near-white pool on the floor (median 100, up to 160 in its middle band) with sharp stool shadows: reads as a raking daylight or a stage spot, not a night room; the floor also looks like pale polished stone
The altar pair is small, grey-white and boxy (median 32 and 26); reads as studio monitors or screens, not tinted smoked acrylic horn speakers
Counter top reads as white marble with a hot sheen (median 135, p95 235), not zinc
Ceiling and beams are saturated orange (r 75, g 36, b 17): grade too warm, the timber loses its brown and the room stops being neutral
A dead black slab between the bar and the listening room (median 13), no detail, reads as a void
Large screen on the right reads as a blank grey canvas with a blurred smudge; flat and lifeless
Banquette foreground is mud-dark (crush 6 %), leather has no sheen
A thin vertical line (the frosted screen's edge, as clear glass) slices through the nearest table; the screens do not read as frosted or glowing
Identical stools repeated eight times with identical backs and angles; no props visible on the near stools; noisy grain overlay across the whole frame

changes.problem: Mother EARF's rims glow like neon, so the hero reads as a sign, not cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: rims saturated blue/green/red near p95 165 against a dark ceiling (median 26); disc faces barely visible in the 2x crop

change.to: 0.02, and add a narrow 2700 K spot from above (or raise the existing hard spot) so the disc faces pick up specular light and the polished edges glow by transmitted light rather than emission

changes.expected: The globe reads as six thick acrylic discs catching light with glowing edges; its colour stays but stops shouting; region p95 drops to about 120-140.

changes.problem: The foreground floor carries a hard, bright pool that reads as daylight or a stage spot and is the brightest large surface in the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 100, profile along y 26 -> 160, sharp stool shadows

change.setting: the Domes' downlights (4 x spot, 32.0 W, 20 deg) and the floor's polish
change.to: 12 W, cone 26 deg with a soft blend, aimed onto the counter top not the floor; floor darker and less polished (honed, mid-dark)

changes.expected: The floor falls into shadow with only soft spill; light pools sit on the counter and tables; the floor median drops to 35-55.

changes.problem: The altar pair is too dim and reads as grey boxes, so the room has no destination.

change.setting: the altar 2 x spot (170.0 W, 2500 K, 30 deg) and the lamps on the speakers
change.to: 260 W, cone 22 deg aimed through the cabinets so the smoked acrylic glows and its edges light; add a low grazing rim from each side if available

changes.expected: Both speakers read as glowing smoked-acrylic objects at the end of the room, median 45-70, with the horn visible.

changes.problem: The grade is too orange: the ceiling and timber lose their brown, which breaks the neutral room.

change.to: 2700, with look AgX - Medium Contrast instead of Medium High Contrast

changes.expected: Timber and ceiling read warm brown; blue channel in the ceiling rises to about 22-28.

changes.problem: The counter top reads as white marble with a hot sheen, not zinc.

change.to: darker grey patina (albedo about 0.35), roughness 0.35-0.45 with faint mottling and ring marks

changes.expected: The counter reads as aged zinc; median 80-110 with a softer highlight.

changes.problem: The black slab between the bar and the listening room and the banquette foreground are empty shadows.

change.setting: haze density and the sink's spot / candles
change.from: haze 0.003; sink spot 18 W; candles 3 W
change.to: haze 0.005; sink spot 30 W; one candle moved or added on the banquette shelf at 4 W so the leather gets a sheen

changes.expected: Shadows hold detail; the slab shows its surface faintly; banquette crush under 2 %.

changes.problem: The large screen on the right reads as a blank grey canvas.

change.to: 0.015 with the frosted acrylic rougher, so the image glows softly from behind instead of reading as grey paint

changes.expected: The screen sits darker than the wall with an even soft glow; median 40-55.

changes.problem: The near stools and tables are empty identical copies; no sign of life in the foreground.

evidence.measured: eight identical stools at identical angles; props sit far back

change.from: coat on a counter chair far back; stools aligned
change.to: rotate each stool 5-15 deg at random; move the coat to the nearest stool and put a record out of its sleeve and a half-drunk coupe on the nearest table

changes.expected: The frame reads lived-in; no pixel test.

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read as solid slotted discs rather than thin hoops, and hang it lower so it is over the banquette table in frame
out_of_scope.why: Its shape and position are product/room design fixed by the card; only its glow and light may change. In this frame it reads as rings, which is why it looks like neon.

out_of_scope.request: Reconsider the full-rainbow colours of Mother EARF in a room meant to be neutral with colour only from the speakers
out_of_scope.why: The owner chose these colours; but as rendered the globe, not the speakers, owns the frame's colour.

out_of_scope.request: Make the frosted banquette screens visibly frosted
out_of_scope.why: Screens are fixed room design; only their roughness may change, which is folded into c7, but the screen nearest the camera currently reads as a clear line through the table.
